claim: Private financing and a stated 2026 orbital test strengthen the ecosystem case for satellite-to-satellite optical power services without establishing orbital efficiency, safety, or commercial viability.

provenance.source_title: Star Catcher financing and stated orbital-test reporting
provenance.fact_summary: Public reporting described substantial financing and a stated 2026 in-space test after terrestrial demonstrations.
provenance.inference_summary: Local orbital optical-power services are a nearer demonstration pathway than bulk terrestrial baseload delivery.
limitations: Financing and a stated test plan are ecosystem evidence, not performance evidence.
No accepted orbital efficiency, pointing, receiver-tolerance, thermal, or safety data.
